reaction: The incoming and outgoing arrows make the completed connection satisfying and easier to follow.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the completed arm to the brain and spinal cord was most worthwhile because it brought the sensory and motor pathways together and explained their role in adjusting movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: The individual pathway fittings were predictable and repetitive, although the touch fitting added a useful explanation.

surprise.text: I expected the touch fibres to connect directly to the skin first; the skin instead attached to the arm and revealed pathway slots.

arbitrary.text: The required order for the skin and touch fibres was not obvious from their descriptions, though the compatibility feedback resolved it.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the links between calcium, muscle contraction and nervous feedback make me curious how the arm's dependence on the rest of the body will be developed.
